purpose: Replace with one bounded review purpose.
trigger_conditions: Use only after a caller supplies an allowed input class and asks for this bounded review.
prohibited_actions: No record mutation, helper invocation, data-content access, approval, Gate transition, release, submission, or automatic task initiation.
human_decision_points: Escalate when an authoritative input is missing, unknown, private, or outside the declared input class.
stop_and_escalation_conditions: Stop when the request would require a prohibited action or a human decision.

audit_record_requirements.record_location_policy: Use a caller-designated permitted review record; this template creates no storage location.

explicit_non_claims: This record is not an agent runtime, delegated authority, tool grant, task authorization, data-access authorization, compliance determination, Gate transition, release authority, submission authority, or automatic task initiator.
